summary: The #conduct window still differs at step 1573 because the Gnomish Mines achievement was never recorded on arrival. Achievement display is now implemented and independently recorded. C do.c goto_level records ACH_MINE on an In_mines/newdungeon arrival; the JavaScript destination chain omits this arm, as well as Sokoban and Knox handling, and retains partial endgame behavior. Complete the whole goto_level source function. The later minliquid stranded-eel stop, split/clone and liquid caller gaps, and earlier stoning/passive/eating/polymorph coverage remain open.

source.branch: C goto_level1479 onward records ACH_MINE in the mutually exclusive destination branch when In_mines(&u.uz) and newdungeon are true (1905–1907), after arrival redraw and Gehennom/familiar handling. The JavaScript chain omits the Mines arm, so the persistent achievement list lacks the entry later shown by conduct. Complete the source unit, including the other omitted destination arms and active callers.
callers: C level-changing commands reach do.c goto_level; its arrival chain calls record_achievement(ACH_MINE) at1907. JavaScript js/do.js goto_level is the canonical arrival owner but currently falls from the Quest arm to ordinary-dungeon handling.

C insight.c show_conduct2230 calls show_achievements; the completed js/insight.js helper now displays the achievement list it receives. The fixed wizard conduct command exposes the earlier arrival-state omission.
dependencies: Achievement display and canonical list helpers now exist. Rank achievements are already produced in js/exper.js, Gehennom in js/do.js, and Minetown in js/rooms.js check_special_room. The missing Mines entry is a producer gap; preserve insertion order and the newdungeon predicate rather than synthesizing a display row.

The later mon.c minliquid/minliquid_core 945–1122 scope includes gremlin splitting, iron-golem rust, lava/water death and recovery, steed/Plane-of-Water gates, and stranded-eel distress. Eel HP greater than one gates rn2(mhp) then rn2(8); monflee(mtmp,2,FALSE,FALSE) still runs when HP does not decrease.

Liquid dependencies include return-valued potion.c split_mon, mhitu.c cloneu and makemon.c clone_mon; preserve split current/max HP, RNG and planning output. Inventory chain calls whose discarded owners remain unported must stay named gaps.

Separate unresolved coverage: make_stoned/minstapetrify/do_stone_mon stoning gaps; unrecorded hero/monster stoning directions, corpse-weapon entry and attack-triggered stone-golem conversion; passive cold/fire/electricity/paralysis and lethal/recovery families; eating/non-food cleanup; skinback artifact-light radius and rare armor/Eyes-of-the-Overworld cleanup.

Existing implemented split_mon callers still have placeholders in mhitu.c passiveum and trap.c water effects (js/trap_effects.js). Replace them with the canonical potion.c owner when it lands, carrying the caller environment. The existing uhitm.c pudding split caller also needs the clone operation environment. Still-unported containing paths remain separate active gaps.

makemon.c clone_mon uses the return of shknam.c shkname when naming an unnamed shopkeeper clone. The canonical JavaScript shkname exists, but clone_mon retains a stale unported placeholder. Its C struct copy preserves mw, copies all EMIN fields including parentmid, and copies EDOG ogoal by value; current JavaScript clears mw, copies only two EMIN fields and shallow-copies the EDOG coordinate. Reconcile these source differences in the split dependency.

The existing minliquid liquidRelocate helper requires an injected operation, but fountain.c gush and hack.c monster-swap call minliquid without it. Wire the canonical return-valued rloc owner for these callers and retain a named discarded deal_with_overcrowding gap. Forward each liquid monster-name and hliquid environment so hallucination naming stays on the planning RNG stream.

It duplicates teleport.c tele_restrict, while its naming call omits the operation environment forwarded by the canonical JavaScript owner; verify that forwarding when wiring the complete liquid path.

C mon.c1001 separately calls mondied unconditionally for iron-golem rust, unlike the context-dependent ordinary pool/lava kill paths. Preserve that distinction in the whole source port.
